company.name: Yelp, Inc.
company.shortDescription: Yelp is an online platform that connects people with great local businesses through user-generated reviews and recommendations.
company.description: Yelp is a technology company that specializes in local business reviews and recommendations. The company provides a platform that enables users to search for local businesses, read reviews, and write their own reviews. Yelp also offers advertising services to help businesses reach potential customers.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (-23 over 90 days) and market heat at 13 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
